findings.message: Converting the address to a `&mut P` (in `with_mut`) even if we don't use `per_cpu_data_mut` is undefined behaviour as the memory is uninitialised.
findings.tp_fp_justification: 初始化路径 per-CPU 镜像未写入数据时 with_mut 将裸地址转 &mut P，对未初始化内存创建可变引用即 UB。作者 'You're right'，改用 core::ptr::write。
